message.content:
I don’t have real‑time access to weather data, so I can’t give you the current conditions. However, here’s a quick snapshot of what you can generally expect in San Francisco:

| Time of Year | Typical Temperature | Typical Weather |
|--------------|---------------------|-----------------|
| **Winter (Dec–Feb)** | 48–58 °F (9–14 °C) | Cool, often cloudy, occasional fog, light rain |
| **Spring (Mar–May)** | 55–65 °F (13–18 °C) | Mild, less fog, occasional showers |
| **Summer (Jun–Aug)** | 57–68 °F (14–20 °C) | Warm, dry, rare fog, occasional heat waves |
| **Fall (Sep–Nov)** | 55–65 °F (13–18 °C) | Mild, decreasing humidity, occasional rain |

If you need the current forecast, you can check a reliable weather site (e.g., Weather.com, AccuWeather, or the National Weather Service) or use a weather app on your phone. Let me know if you’d like a quick summary of the forecast for a specific date!
